population.definition: Dodoma City, 2022 Population and Housing Census (held 23 Aug to 4 Sep 2022, NBS). The citypopulation.de page does not define the unit further (lists it under 'Urban'); I could not read the NBS tables directly. Census dates from The Citizen.

source.title: Dodoma City (population by census)
source.publisher: citypopulation.de (states source: National Bureau of Statistics Tanzania)
source.quote: 765,179 (2022 census figure for Dodoma City; page names the National Bureau of Statistics Tanzania as source)

facts.claim: Before the 20th century the site held a small settlement of some Gogo clans; by 1907 the Germans had built a central railroad there.

source.title: Dodoma, Tanzania (Research Starters)
source.author: Beverly Ballaro
source.quote: a small settlement of some clans of the Gogo

facts.claim: Dodoma became the capital after a 1973 decision to move the seat from Dar es Salaam; its central location and more comfortable climate drew officials.

source.title: Dodoma, Tanzania (Research Starters)
source.author: Beverly Ballaro
source.quote: its central location and more comfortable climate

facts.claim: The 1973 plan, approved by the party conference, expected a ten-year move but it took roughly fifty years; real progress came under President Magufuli.

source.title: Dodoma: The making of the nation's capital (Part 1)
source.author: Paul Owere
source.quote: In October 1973, the decision was approved by the 16th biennial Party conference and with that the die was cast.

facts.claim: Dodoma is the political and administrative capital; Dar es Salaam remains the economic and cultural hub.

source.title: Dodoma, Tanzania (Research Starters)
source.author: Beverly Ballaro
source.quote: Dar es Salaam remains the country's economic and cultural hub

facts.claim: Moving the capital was argued to be more economically viable than restructuring Dar es Salaam.

source.title: Dodoma: The making of the nation's capital (Part 1)
source.author: Paul Owere
source.quote: a more economically viable alternative than attempting to reorganise and restructure Dar es Salaam

timeline.claim: Germans had built a central railroad through Dodoma.

source.title: Dodoma, Tanzania (Research Starters)
source.author: Beverly Ballaro
source.quote: By 1907, the Germans had built a central railroad

timeline.claim: A Legislative Council debate judged Dodoma ideal for the capital, but the idea was shelved over cost.

source.title: Dodoma: The making of the nation's capital (Part 1)
source.author: Paul Owere
source.quote: The idea was, however, shelved due to the high costs of transferring all the government departments

timeline.claim: TANU decided on full relocation to Dodoma within 10 years (declared August 1973; conference approval October 1973).

source.title: How relocation to Dodoma began
source.author: Hilda Mhagama
source.quote: TANU declared in August 1973 that a full relocation to Dodoma should take place within 10 years.

timeline.claim: Parliament moved to Dodoma, but the transfer stalled for lack of offices.

source.title: Dodoma, Tanzania (Research Starters)
source.author: Beverly Ballaro
source.quote: Parliament moved in 1996

timeline.claim: President Magufuli ordered a full, immediate move to Dodoma.

source.title: Samia completes 50-year journey of establishing Dodoma as capital
source.author: Jacob Mosenda
source.quote: until 2017, when former President John Magufuli ordered a full, immediate move to Dodoma

timeline.claim: Early 2020: Job Ndugai Market officially began operations.

source.title: Six years on, Dodoma's Job Ndugai Market struggles to attract traders
source.author: The Citizen Reporter
source.quote: officially began operations in early 2020

timeline.claim: New State House at Chamwino, Dodoma inaugurated.

source.title: Two men behind newly launched Tanzania's State House structures
source.author: Sauli Giliard and Esther Takwa
source.quote: inauguration ceremony of the new Ikulu structures on Saturday, May 20, 2023

places.name: Job Ndugai Central Market
places.what: A large purpose-built market in Nzuguni Ward on the outskirts of Dodoma. It began operating in early 2020 to relieve older, overcrowded markets such as Majengo.

source.title: Six years on, Dodoma's Job Ndugai Market struggles to attract traders
source.author: The Citizen Reporter
source.quote: built in Nzuguni Ward at a cost of more than Sh14 billion

source.title: Six years on, Dodoma's Job Ndugai Market struggles to attract traders

source.quote: officially began operations in early 2020

facts.label: Majengo Market
facts.value: Described as renowned; a modernisation project was ordered in 2025

source.title: DC orders Majengo Market contractor to work 24/7
source.author: Daily News reporter
source.quote: aims to modernise infrastructure at the renowned Majengo Market in Dodoma

places.name: Bunge (Parliament) complex
places.what: The seat of Tanzania's National Assembly in Dodoma. The government is enlarging the parliament grounds.

source.title: Bunge area set for expansion
source.author: Rodgers Luhwago
source.quote: will now expand from the current 42,312 to 162, 236 square metres

facts.label: Compensation
facts.value: 12.216 bn/- paid to owners of annexed land

source.title: Bunge area set for expansion
source.author: Rodgers Luhwago
source.quote: to compensate the area owners

places.name: Chamwino State House (Ikulu)
places.what: The presidential office and administration complex in Chamwino, Dodoma. It was inaugurated in May 2023.

source.title: Two men behind newly launched Tanzania's State House structures
source.author: Sauli Giliard and Esther Takwa
source.quote: inauguration ceremony of the new Ikulu structures on Saturday, May 20, 2023

facts.label: Builder
facts.value: Tanzania People's Defence Forces National Service wing, locally funded (article paraphrase)

source.author: Sauli Giliard and Esther Takwa
source.quote: office and administration blocks of the State House at Chamwino

facts.label: Role
facts.value: Houses presidential offices and official residence

source.author: Jacob Mosenda
source.quote: the inauguration of the new State House building in Chamwino, Dodoma

places.name: University of Dodoma
places.what: A public university on a large campus east of the city. It was established in 2007.

source.title: The University Establishment
source.quote: was established in the year 2007

facts.label: Location
facts.value: About 7 km east of the city

source.title: The University Establishment
source.quote: approximately 7 kilometers east of Dodoma city

source.title: The University Establishment
source.quote: 6,000 hectares

places.name: Dodoma vineyards and wine
places.what: Dodoma Region is Tanzania's main grape-growing area. Growers rely heavily on the Makutupora grape.

facts.label: Share of grapes
facts.value: More than 70 per cent of national production

source.title: From five acres to thriving vineyard
source.author: Esther Kasanga
source.quote: accounting for more than 70 per cent of Tanzania's grape production

source.title: From five acres to thriving vineyard
source.author: Esther Kasanga
source.quote: Most of us rely heavily on Makutupora grapes.
